Marisa: Quick heads-up — VeloxBiotics has a ~60% drop in daily API volume starting 2025-03-20. Renewal window ~6 weeks. New PM (Elena) started last week and I heard they lost access to our internal docs. :thinking_face:
Derek: Do we have raw numbers + which routes dropped? single team or org-wide?
Marisa: Single org slug (prod). Pulled a quick query from metrics:
```
date       | total_calls
2025-03-18 | 14,200
2025-03-19 | 13,800
2025-03-20 | 6,000
2025-03-21 | 5,600
```
Most of the drop is on /generate and embed batch jobs.
Olivia (CSM): Thanks — sounds like an onboarding/stakeholder handoff issue more than tech. I can kick off a 15-min intro with Elena and our solutions lead. @Ryan, want me to include procurement? :calendar:
Ryan (AE): Yes please include procurement. Renewal mid-May is the timeline I have. If they're re-evaluating, we should surface a short "stability + cost" one-pager and offer a 90-day guardrail (discounted reserved capacity) to reduce churn risk.
Marisa: I posted links to the playbook and recent runbook in the thread: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/velox-onboard. Elena's email is elena@veloxbio.io — she replied to our kickoff invite but didn't accept yet.
onboarding-bot: Playbook version used by VeloxBiotics: v2.1.4. Last training session completed: 2025-02-10.
Derek: Any errors in logs, or auth failures after their PM change?
Marisa: No 401 spikes. Error rates steady. This looks like feature-flag or access removal (they told our SE their data-science team lost the API token during the org change).
Olivia (CSM): Proposed outreach: 1) 15-min sync with Elena + SE to restore token/access, 2) quick review of top 3 usage patterns, 3) offer discounted reserved burst for 90 days while they stabilize. I can draft email now and ping Elena.
Ryan (AE): If we do the 90-day guardrail, let's get a mini SOW and legal signoff ASAP. I can draft terms and route to legal. Also propose a short FAQ for procurement about cost predictability.
Marisa: Action items: @Olivia draft outreach email + schedule sync (due EOD today); @Ryan prepare 90-day guardrail term sheet (due tomorrow); Derek to validate that no infra/customer-ticket work is required (pull logs + confirm no regression). I'll follow up on token restore once we have the call. :white_check_mark:
Olivia (CSM): Drafted email, dropping below and will send after Marisa approves:
"Hi Elena — welcome! Quick note: we saw a drop in calls tied to a missing token after your team re-org. Can we do a 15-min sync today to restore access and walk through two quick fixes that usually resolve this? Also we can put a short 90-day reserved capacity in place while you onboard. —Olivia"
Marisa: Looks good, send it. I'll be on the call.
Ryan (AE): I'll attach the draft SOW and the procurement FAQ in the invite once it's accepted.
Derek: Confirmed — logs + traces clean, no regression. Landing ETA for token restore: same day as sync if they give us the token or approve our token rotation flow.
Marisa: Great — keeping this thread for status. Will update after the sync. :eyes:
